title: Lazy Sunday Australian Beef Skillet
description: A hearty, yeasty, and crisp Australian dish featuring pecan nuts and rest-meat, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and is FODMAP-friendly.

ingredients.name: beef strips
ingredients.notes: rest meat, sliced into thin strips

instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, toss the beef strips with garlic-free seasoning, yeast extract, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil on the hot stone plate and cook the beef strips for 5 minutes, or until browned.
Add the sliced onion to the hot stone plate and cook for an additional 3 minutes, or until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the chopped pecan nuts and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Serve the beef and onion mixture hot, garnished with additional pecan nuts if desired.
